items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Which a boy called Alex Statt used to play bass with. [INTERVIEWEE] And banjo, you know, he seemed to Chris could do the other band.

ctx.x: I was a blue rider. I saw a Georgia boy. He was a great kid. He was a great kid. He was a great kid. Well, back to Chris Kelly.
Did he have a banjo player? A bass player? Banjo. Yeah, banjo player. Which a boy called Alex Statt used to play bass with.

And banjo, you know, he seemed to Chris could do the other band. Mm-hmm . Did he have a good funeral? Hmm? What kind of funeral did he have? What kind of funeral, man? He paid the Arnold back. Chris Keller, Sam Morgan, and Lorde Duran. He paid with the Arnold, Chris. Oh, man.
